"''Do not take too long. That is Mining Guild territory.|[[Sabine Wren]] and [[Hondo Ohnaka]]|}} The '''Sereeda Waypoint''' was a [[hyperspace]] [[Hyperspace waypoint|waypoint]] in [[the Slice]] and [[Outer Rim Territories]] regions of [[the galaxy]], falling within grid square T-7 on the [[Standard Galactic Grid]]. In [[2 BBY]],{{RebelsDate|301}} it was located in [[Mining Guild]] claims territory, which had jurisdiction in the area and routinely patrolled it. The [[Spectres]], traveling from the [[planet]] [[Atollon]], had to stop here to recalculate navigation coordinates [[Mission to Reklam Station|on their way]] to the [[Yarma system]]. ==Appearances== *''[[Star Wars Rebels: Steps Into Shadow]]'' {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{GalaxyMapPoster}} {{MapPoint}} *''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations, New Edition]]'' {{MapPoint}} *{{StarWarsGalaxyMap}} {{MapPoint}} *{{GalaxyMapAppendix}} {{ID|Sereeda}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Paso de Sereeda |fr=Étape hyperspatiale de Sereeda |ja=セリーダ中継点 |pl=Punkt nawigacyjny Sereeda }} [[Category:Hyperspace waypoints and jump points]] [[Category:Outer Rim Territories locations]] [[Category:The Slice locations]]
